quotes.speaker: Tyrese Proctor
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Proctor on his growth and improved confidence this season
quotes.excerpt: I think it started last year, obviously getting familiar with the system, players, and we added players.
quotes.quote: I think it started last year, obviously getting familiar with the system, players, and we added players off the All-Star break in that trade deadline. And then I think it just started this summer, just locking in on my habits, my routine, my work, just doubling down on myself and putting the work in and then came in the training camp firing and sort of never looked back from there.
quotes.social_post: Tyrese Proctor credits his breakout season to locking in on his habits and routine during the summer and doubling down on his work.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Proctor
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Proctor on the team's collective effort and ball movement

quotes.quote: We just played together. I thought we moved as one, we were connected the whole game. quotes.speaker: Tyrese Proctor
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Proctor on the team's resilience and depth
quotes.excerpt: We got 1 through 15 guys that can go out there and play good basketball.
quotes.quote: I think it just shows how resilient we are, how connected we are, how deep we are as one. We got 1 through 15 guys that can go out there and play good basketball and I thought we showcased that tonight. Everyone stepped up. Malik had 20, JT showed, what did JT have? He played great. quotes.speaker: Thomas Bryant
quotes.summary_phrase: Thomas Bryant on the team's resilience during a difficult travel day
quotes.excerpt: The significance about it was just throughout the whole day, not being able to travel yesterday.
quotes.quote: The significance about it was just throughout the whole day, not being able to travel yesterday, to having to travel on the day of the game and then being able for guys to be, you know, guys that weren't available and the guys that were available to step up and you know get a resilient win today.
quotes.social_post: Thomas Bryant on the Cavs win after a tough travel day: It was a resilient win today after not being able to travel yesterday and having to travel on the day of the game.

quotes.speaker: Thomas Bryant
quotes.summary_phrase: Thomas Bryant on Tyrese Proctor's performance and development
quotes.excerpt: He's just gotten so much better year by year, man. It's just, I'm grateful to be a part.
quotes.quote: I thought he played fantastic from start to finish, man. He got us in our right spots, he made big plays for us, he got downhill when they were giving him the lane, made big threes for us and you know he's just gotten so much better year by year, man. It's just, I'm grateful to be a part of it and to help him in any way, shape or form, man, but he played fantastic, man. You can't say enough great things about him and the game that he had today.
quotes.social_post: Thomas Bryant on Tyrese Proctor: He played fantastic from start to finish. He got us in our right spots and he has just gotten so much better year by year.

structured.context: Thomas Bryant praises the performance and development of his teammate Tyrese Proctor.

quotes.speaker: Thomas Bryant
quotes.summary_phrase: Thomas Bryant on the team's culture and Tyrese Proctor's role
quotes.excerpt: We didn't want him to change up anything. You're not stepping on anybody's toes right here, man.
quotes.quote: I'm just seeing everybody just bringing them in and just wanting him to play his game, you know. We didn't want him to change up anything. You're not stepping on anybody's toes right here, man. It's just going out here and play some winning basketball. quotes.speaker: Thomas Bryant
quotes.summary_phrase: Thomas Bryant on how Tyrese Proctor's growth impacts his own game
quotes.excerpt: It makes my job even easier, man. All I got to do is just roll to the basket.
quotes.quote: It's grown so much, just he's just settling into our offense, man, and just taking the making the reads and it makes my job even easier, man. All I got to do is just roll to the basket and get the open shot or or pick and pop and get the open shot from a man and you know from Tyrese and Malik, man, they make my job easier when they can just do what they do, create on their own and then you know I'm just there to help them out.
quotes.social_post: Thomas Bryant says Tyrese Proctor's growth makes his job easier: He is settling into our offense and making the reads, so all I have to do is roll to the basket.

structured.context: Thomas Bryant explains how the playmaking of Tyrese Proctor and Malik Beasley makes his own job easier.

quotes.speaker: Thomas Bryant
quotes.summary_phrase: Thomas Bryant on the team's spirit and proving doubters wrong
quotes.excerpt: I feel like it helped energize the group a lot, man. This is a really big resilient win.
quotes.quote: I feel like it helped energize the group a lot, man. This is a really big resilient win against a great Dallas team that had guys playing, you know, they had some guys up and not as many of us and then you know, being on the back end of just, you know, everybody saying that we weren't supposed to, we weren't going to win this, we weren't going to do this, weren't going to do that and then just to prove everybody wrong in that in that stature, man, it feels great.
quotes.social_post: Thomas Bryant on proving doubters wrong: Everybody was saying we weren't going to win this, so to prove everybody wrong in that stature feels great.

structured.context: Thomas Bryant reacts to the team's win against the Dallas Mavericks despite external doubts.
